description: Standardized application requirement profiles mapping deployment scenarios to security, performance, latency, and memory requirements on a 1-5 scale.

profiles.name: Banking & Financial Services
profiles.description: Payment gateways, core banking transactions, and high-value financial transfers requiring strong long-term confidentiality and strict latency bounds.

profiles.name: IoT & Resource-Constrained Embedded
profiles.description: Smart home sensors, industrial IoT nodes, and battery-powered microcontrollers with tight RAM, flash memory, and compute power limits.

profiles.name: Cloud & High-Throughput Data Center
profiles.description: Web servers, API gateways, TLS termination proxies, and microservices needing maximum operations per second and multi-core scalability.

profiles.name: Mobile & Edge Devices
profiles.description: Smartphones, tablets, and mobile apps balancing battery life, interactive user experience, and mobile network constraints.

profiles.name: Healthcare & Patient Records
profiles.description: Electronic health records (EHR), medical telemetry, and HIPAA-compliant data exchange requiring decades of post-quantum data privacy.

profiles.name: Government & Critical Infrastructure
profiles.description: Classified communication, defense systems, energy grid control, and national security infrastructure requiring NIST Category 5 maximum security.
